fullDescription:
Florencia Calista is an elegant high-contrast serif display font designed to bring a sophisticated, editorial, and luxurious character to your creative projects. With its bold presence, refined serifs, and fashionable proportions, this typeface is perfect for designs that need a strong yet graceful visual identity.

Its timeless style works beautifully for fashion branding, luxury logos, beauty products, perfume packaging, jewelry identity, wedding stationery, editorial layouts, magazine covers, invitations, posters, packaging, social media graphics, and premium product branding.

Florencia Calista is especially suited to feminine and high-end visual identities where elegant typography needs to become the main design element.

Florencia Calista is made for designers who want to create an elegant, luxurious, and memorable typographic identity.
